title: Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (Redeem in-Store) @ NBL
body:
Deal: Free Hungry Jack's Cheeseburger (Redeem in-Store) @ NBL

[kumquat] Thankyou Nick Rakocevic for your first quarter blessings
[eathb] Zylan Cheatham missed two as well, we should be allowed double the amount!
[Selenium] It's not just for NSW, by the way.
No interest in NBL so, hopefully an Ozbargainer that does will share the love, lol.
[INFIDEL] Received email of offer in Qld.
But as only a free cheeseburger - not interested.
[Royale with cheese] A true ozbargainer knows how to make one Cheeseburger into many.
[INFIDEL] A true ozbargainer knows how to make one Cheeseburger WHOPPER into many…
Just sign up for FREE Birthday WHOPPER @HJ. An offer (possibly each day) automatically repeated each year😉
Got 2 free last month🍔
[ATTS] @INFIDEL: 365 whoppers in a year
Lol the staff remember my face already and i dont go too often
I dont like my chances claiming a whopper evwry day lol
[TheDukeOfNukem] Got an email about this earlier, I live in VIC, though my account has been used in NSW & QLD so idk. But I don't think it's limited to NSW.
[Embaloo] Has the game already finished or is underway? Hard to tell from the app and the time zone differences…
If you have to subscribe to the nbl marketing, the link is down the very bottom of this page:
https://www.nbl.com.au/
[Royale with cheese] Looks like one is on. Started watching for the team for last few minutes. Fingers crossed
[Wiadro] Check Your Email.
Your Free Burger Is Coming.
[Windy711] This voucher can only be redeemed at Hungry Jacks, Victoria?
[SuHao] @Windy711: Same question, wtf
/Update: clicked the link in email, redeemed it at nearby HJ in SA. No problem
[Windy711] @SuHao: Thanks for your update. I’ll try the voucher in NSW tomorrow.
[ShouldIBuyIt] You're the real MVP!
$1 minimum spend. Am I the only buying $1 worth of sauce?
[JHoliday] Where do you put the code?
Woops was looking in HJ app… never mind
[Royale with cheese] NBL app. I clicked on their HJ story at the top. It then sends you the link.
[RickyJ] I'm in the NBL app and clicked the HJ logo at the top. I wasn't sent a link and can't see where to enter the code
Edit: I was actually sent a link via push notification to my phone. I checked my email.
[JHoliday] How do you subscribe to NBL email marketing communications?
[Royale with cheese] I presume it is automatic when you sign up. I got the link via email and it added the voucher to my HJ app
[Royale with cheese] HACK: If you open email incognito, you can practically add the voucher to many different HJ accounts using the same link from NBL.
[scrypton] @OP the email says:
This voucher expires on Sunday 20th September at 6:00pm AEST and can only be redeemed at Hungry Jacks, Victoria.
Perhaps you can update the title of the post? Cheers.
[Royale with cheese] Allowing me to add locally. I haven't ordered though
[seanbaussie] Yeah, mine said that too, but I think they've messed up the t&c's
Rules of promotion
If the AWAY team misses two consecutive free-throw shots in a single penalty, fans get a free cheeseburger at Hungry Jack's. The shots must be two consecutive missed free-throw shots in a single penalty;
The fans in attendance and at home can win a free cheese burger at Hungry Jack’s
To be redeemed in-store prior to 6pm the following day (post game)
The fan acknowledges that only one (1) state can be nominated for burger redemption. This is determined off the post code entered by the fan, when the fan enters the competition for the first time
Fans must show their game day ticket or membership card or digital voucher for a free burger
[JHoliday] Anyone else keep getting this?
Expired
You have already claimed a burger for this game
[scrypton] I encountered the same on some browsers. I assume it was an ad blocker issue, so I used my phone and turned off my ad blocker and it works.
[liamisred] Yeah I get an error then it says I've already claimed
[IRON] Code word for the Perth Wildcats vs SEM Phoenix game is Double
[Royale with cheese] Haha yes got it but says i used it already
[JHoliday] Different codes for different states?
Anyone got it to work in QLD?
[AsukaST] It says something went wrong at the first time, then when I try again, it says I've already claim it…
Never received email… What?
[CW66WC] Same here.
Could be related, if you try to log in to the NBL website using the email code option, you get an error:
"Message failed: 421 Domain mgmail.nbl.com.au is not allowed to send: Your account is on probation and domains are limited to 100 messages / hour."
Perhaps NBL have been sending too many emails and got flagged by their email provider?
[welcomeUniverseWorld] I should have read the t&c first.
"This voucher expires on Sunday 20th September at 6:00pm AEST and can only be redeemed at Hungry Jacks, Victoria."
[LegitBox] Sorry, youve reached the maximum free burger allowed on this round
[QuickToThePointless] HJ cheesburgers are like oreos - you need at least 6 or you'll be left unsatiated and unsatisfied.
And support the NBL wherever you can - it's a high quality league that gets better each year
[shortgum] HJ marketing is ridiculously generous since early this year,
FREE on shake: hash brown, toastie, snack rappa, chick royal. not terribly hard to get. also birthday whopper
now also an option for a free cheeseburger
not that I am against it at all but I hope HJ is doing a good match against MCD because their offers are really shyt
